## FuseMax: Spatial Array Architecture for Attention Acceleration

术语解释
FuseMax是一种基于TPUv2/TPUv3风格spatial array architecture的专用attention加速器，通过1-pass Einsum cascade + deep fusion + fine-grain binding实现在2D和1D PE array上接近100%的compute utilization，且on-chip buffer需求和off-chip memory traffic均与sequence length无关。

术语是什么？
FuseMax架构由以下组件组成：(1) **2D PE Array**：PE从TPU固定数据流MAC（Figure 3a）→FLAT灵活数据流MAC（Figure 3b）→FuseMax灵活数据流MAC+指数运算（Figure 3c）演进。FuseMax PE使用6个sequential MAC实现exponentiation（无dedicated exp unit，基于Taylor series [36]）。2D array同时执行tensor products（BQK: Q×K^T）和softmax exponentiation（SLN = e^{BQK-RM}）。(2) **1D PE Array**：256 PEs，通过fixed-latency neighbor-neighbor links直连2D array底部。执行softmax的sum/max/reduce操作（SLD=ΣSLN, RM update, PRM correction, RD/RNV running accumulation）和final division（AV = RNV/RD）。(3) **Global Buffer + DRAM**：off-chip DRAM→large on-chip global buffer→2D/1D arrays。(4) **Inter-PE Communication Network**：2D array内部low-cost neighbor-neighbor links（每cycle每条link都active），2D bottom→1D connections。参数设置：PE array dimension与FLAT cloud accelerator匹配，global buffer容量使total area与FLAT等面积（FuseMax实际小6.4%），940 MHz @45nm。(5) **PE间异构性**：2D PEs做MAC+exp，1D PEs做add/max/multiply/divide，与GPU的同构PE+large per-PE storage形成对比。

从硬件架构角度拆解术语：
FuseMax在attention layer上的硬件执行流程（以BERT-Base, seq len=256K, 单个M0×P0 tile为例）：
```
时间线 (Epoch i):
  [2D Array]:
    t0-tE: BQK tile fill → Q_{e,p}沿E dimension streaming broadcast → K_{e,m0} stationary → PE执行MACC → 产生BQK_{m0,p0} tile → spatial drain to 1D
    tE+1-t2E: SLNV tile fill → SLN_{m0,p0}=exp(BQK-RM) via 6×sequential MAC → BV_{f,m0} streaming → PE执行SLN×BV → 产生SLNV_{f,p0} tile → spatial drain
    cycle-level interleave: BQK|SLNV交错 → 相邻cycle分别计算BQK和SLNV → 所有neighbor links始终active
  [1D Array]:
    tE_drain: 接收BQK drain → reduce across M0 → LM_{p0}=max(BQK_{:,p0})
    tE+correction: RM_update = max(RM_old, LM) → PRM=exp(RM_old-RM_new) → SPD=RD×PRM → RD_new=SLD+SPD
    t2E_drain: 接收SLNV drain → SPNV=RNV_old×PRM → RNV_new=SLNV+SPNV
  最终: RNV_{M1} / RD_{M1} → AV output
```
Epoch间pipeline（software pipelining）：Epoch i处理tile coordinates (a,b,c,d)，Epoch i+1处理(a+1,b+1,c+1,d+1)。BQK/LM的tile d在Epoch i完成，但其RM在后续epoch执行（因需等drain）。不同epoch的tile coordinates overlap → 隐藏fill/drain latency（~256 cycles fill/drain vs 64 cycles compute per tile）。

术语一般如何实现？如何使用？
FuseMax的硬件实现需要minimal changes to standard spatial architecture：PE仅需增加exponentiation功能（6 sequential MACs，~6× area overhead for exp logic），其余与FLAT PE相同。整体area比FLAT小6.4%（因减少了global buffer需求——1-pass cascade消除了O(M) live footprint）。FuseMax不能直接应用于GPU：GPU的homogeneous PEs + large per-PE storage + expensive inter-PE communication与FuseMax的heterogeneous PEs + small per-PE storage + cheap neighbor communication相反。FuseMax利用2D-1D tight coupling static schedule compute，无需GPU所需的frequent synchronization。Artifact开源：https://github.com/FPSG-UIUC/micro24-fusemax-artifact（Timeloop+Accelergy models + Docker + Jupyter notebooks）。

涉及论文标题：
- 5-FuseMax_Leveraging_Extended_Einsums_to_Optimize_Attention_Accelerator_Design.pdf

## Algorithmic Minimum Live Footprint (from Cascade of Einsums)

术语解释
Algorithmic Minimum Live Footprint是从Cascade of Einsums的dependency分析中推导出的、在任意mapping下kernel中各tensor所需的最小on-chip buffer size。它是mapping-independent的lower bound——任何scheduling/dataflow/mapping都无法使tensor的live footprint低于此值。

术语是什么？
Live footprint指某tensor在执行过程中同时需要保持在on-chip memory中的数据量。给定Einsum cascade，通过分析is-ﬁbertree的read-after-write dependencies可以确定：(1) 哪些tensor的哪些fiber需要在多个Einsum间跨越pass边界（即必须在完成该fiber的所有element处理后才能被下一Einsum re-read）；(2) 该fiber的shape决定了algorithmic minimum live footprint。例如，3-pass attention cascade中QK tensor（shape M×P）的M fiber在Pass 1（QK+GM）完成后需在Pass 2（SN计算）re-read → live footprint至少为M×P（完整的QK tensor）。1-pass cascade通过running max消除了跨pass dependency → QK的live footprint仅为M0×P0（tile size），与总M无关。

从kernel调度角度拆解术语：
以Cascade 1（pedagogical 2-pass cascade）的live footprint分析为例：
```
Cascade 1:  Y = A_k × B_k    (Einsum 5)
            Z = Y × A_k      (Einsum 6)
```
- Dependency: Einsum 6（read A_k）必须在Einsum 5（also read A_k）完成所有K fiber元素后才能start——因为Einsum 5产生Y，而Einsum 6同时需要Y和A_k。即使fusion can produce/consume tiles of Y，也无法避免re-read A_k的K fiber。
- Live footprint of A: 至少K fiber size（shape K）。若buffer不够 → 必须spill+reload → memory traffic ∝ K。
- 若reassociate为Cascade 2（defer Y×）：Einsum 7 Y=A_k×B_k + Einsum 8 X=A_k（reduce away K rank）→ same pass → 1-pass of K。
- Live footprint of A: 可小至tile size → buffer requirement不随K growth。

FuseMax将此分析应用于attention：
```
3-pass attention: QK_{m,p} live footprint = M × P  (whole tensor)
                   → seq len = 1M, P = 64, fp16 → ~128 MB
                   → exceeds on-chip buffer → spill to DRAM
1-pass attention: QK_{m0,p0} live footprint = M0 × P0  (tile on 2D array)
                   → M0 ≈ 16, P0 ≈ 16 → ~512 B
                   → always fits on-chip
```

术语一般如何实现？如何使用？
Live footprint分析用于：(1) accelerator on-chip buffer sizing——给定target sequence length range，确定所需最小buffer capacity；(2) algorithm selection——为给定buffer budget选择合适pass数的cascade；(3) fusion scheduling——确定哪些Einsum可安全fuse而不超出buffer capacity。FuseMax使用此分析证明1-pass cascade的buffer需求与seq len无关（仅取决于tile size M0×P0和P0×P2 partition），因此可处理任意长seq（1M+ tokens）而无需spill。此分析是mapping-independent的——对给定cascade，任何mapping/scheduling/binding都受此live footprint lower bound约束。

涉及论文标题：
- 5-FuseMax_Leveraging_Extended_Einsums_to_Optimize_Attention_Accelerator_Design.pdf

## Mapping and Binding for Spatial Accelerator Architectures

术语解释
Mapping和Binding是描述computation（由cascade of Einsums指定）如何具体调度到spatial accelerator硬件上的两个层级概念。Mapping定义logical tasks和它们之间的dependency graph；Binding定义这些tasks到具体硬件的assignment（compute unit、time、memory location）。

术语是什么？
**Mapping**：将Einsum cascade的iteration space points分组为logical tasks（可小至单点或大至整个iteration space），形成task graph（DAG，nodes=tasks, edges=dependencies）。Mapping spec包含loop order、partitioning/tiling、work scheduling（sequential vs parallel）等。这些dependencies可以是：(1) true dependencies（由cascade的Einsum间的data dependency强制）；(2) ordering constraints（由mapping spec额外添加，如serialization for correctness）。例如Mapping 1（FuseMax mapping）定义了对M和P的双重tiling（M1×M0, P2×P1×P0），M0×P0映射到2D PE array，并在M0/P0层maximally fuse所有Einsum（ComputeRNVTile包含Einsums 44-54，ComputeAVTile为Einsum 55，在P2层fuse）。

**Binding**：将task graph中的每个task分配到具体hardware resources——哪个compute unit执行、何时执行、inputs/outputs在memory hierarchy中的位置。Binding需遵守：(1) task graph的dependencies；(2) architecture的物理限制（PE数量、buffer sizes、NoC topology、communication latency）。FuseMax的binding通过两级interleaving实现：(a) Epoch-level pipelining——不同epoch处理不同tile-relative coordinates的tiles；(b) Cycle-level intra-epoch interleaving——2D array内BQK和SLNV交替计算，1D array内SPNV和RNV交替计算。

从kernel调度角度拆解术语：
FuseMax Mapping 1的loopnest结构：
```
for p2 in 0..P2:         # P = P2 × P1 × P0
  for m1 in 0..M1:       # M = M1 × M0
    for p1 in 0..P1:
      parallel_for p0 in 0..P0:   # mapped to 2D array columns
        parallel_for m0 in 0..M0: # mapped to 2D array rows
          # Fused Einsums 44-54 (ComputeRNVTile):
          BQK[m1,m0,p] = Q[e,p] × BK[e,m1,m0]     # Einsum 44
          LM[m1,p] = max_m0(BQK[m1,m0,p])          # Einsum 45
          RM[m1+1,p] = max(RM[m1,p], LM[m1,p])     # Einsum 46
          SLN[m1,m0,p] = exp(BQK - RM[m1+1,p])     # Einsum 47
          ...
    for p1 in 0..P1:
      parallel_for p0 in 0..P0:
        # Einsum 55 (ComputeAVTile):
        AV[f,p] = RNV[f,M1,p] / RD[M1,p]           # Einsum 55
```
Binding的关键设计决策：
- M0×P0 = #2D PEs（而非更小或更大）→ 最大化parallelism；
- BQK和SLNV在2D array上cycle-level interleave → 隐藏BQK的fill/drain latency → 每cycle所有links active；
- RM需等LM drain → 安排在后续epoch执行（而非stall当前epoch）→ epoch间pipeline重叠；
- 最终division AV在第2个p1 loop单独执行（因RNV/RD需完整M1 traversal后才能使用）。

术语一般如何实现？如何使用？
Mapping和binding的形式化概念源于TeAAL [35]和Timeloop [41]。Timeloop提供automated mapping space search（对单个Einsum搜索loop order/tiling/parallelization）；但cascade-level的binding（如FuseMax的epoch-level + cycle-level interleaving）需手动设计，因Timeloop不原生支持cross-Einsum interleaving。Looptree [21]和TileFlow [62]探索了fused-layer dataflow search但限于有限的transformation space，FuseMax的inter-Einsum interleaving type尚不可被这些工具自动discover。在FPGA systolic array compiler（如AutoSA [54]）中，mapping tuning聚焦于PE array allocation和I/O scheduling。在GPU上，mapping对应于grid/block/thread decomposition + shared memory tiling，binding对应于warp scheduling + register allocation。

涉及论文标题：
- 5-FuseMax_Leveraging_Extended_Einsums_to_Optimize_Attention_Accelerator_Design.pdf

## Fine-grain Intra-Epoch Interleaving (Cycle-level Spatial Array Binding)

术语解释
Fine-grain Intra-Epoch Interleaving是FuseMax在spatial array的单个epoch内部、以cycle粒度交错执行不同类型Einsum的binding技术，使2D和1D PE array的utilization接近100%。

术语是什么？
在spatial array architecture上，每个tile的computation需要fill（加载数据到PEs）、compute（PE内计算）、drain（spatial reduction输出）三个阶段。传统non-interleaved binding（如+Architecture配置）fully produce和consume一个tile后再start下一个→fill/drain期间PEs idle。FuseMax的intra-epoch interleaving在单epoch内：(1) 2D array上cycle-level交替BQK（Q×K^T matmul）和SLNV（SLN×V matmul+reduce）→'BQK|SLNV' notation；(2) 1D array上同时进行SPNV（correction of old running num×V）和RNV（accumulation of new num×V）→'SPNV|RNV' notation。每cycle所有neighbor-neighbor links都active（carrying either BQK or SLNV data）。Interleaving依赖tight coupling between 2D and 1D arrays实现static schedule，无需GPU所需的frequent synchronization。

从kernel调度角度拆解术语：
以2×2 toy array的intra-epoch interleaving为例（Figure 5 of FuseMax）：
```
Time:    t=0        t=1        t=2        t=3        t=4
2D Array:
  PE(0,0): BV0→     -          SLN0×BV0   -          ...    (BQK|SLNV alternating)
  PE(0,1): -         BV1→      -          SLN1×BV1   ...
  PE(1,0): BK0→      BK0       BK0→       BK0        ...    (BK stationary for BQK)
  PE(1,1): BK1→      BK1       BK1→       BK1        ...
1D Array:
  PE(0):   -         -          SPNV0      SPNV0+...   ...   (SPNV|RNV alternating)
  PE(1):   -         -          RNV_old    RNV_new    ...

Link activity (each cycle):
  link(0,0)→(0,1): BV0 move    -          SLN0×BV0 move   -          ...
  link(1,0)→(1,1): BK0 move    -          BK0 move        -          ...
  link(0,0)→(0,1): Q broadcast Q          Q broadcast     Q          ... (BQK phase)
  link(0,0)→(0,1): -           V broadcast -              V broadcast ... (SLNV phase)
```
Key: (1) BQK的E×M0×P0 iteration space需要E cycles→fill/drain各需~4E cycles（output stationary dataflow）。若无interleaving，2D array在fill+drain期间idle（utilization = E/(E+8E) ≈ 11%）。Interleaving使SLNV的compute overlap在BQK的fill/drain期间→utilization → ~100%。(2) 1D array在等待2D drain时不idle，而是处理前一轮的SPNV/RNV（使用已在buffer中的旧running values）。

术语一般如何实现？如何使用？
Intra-epoch interleaving实现需要：(1) PE支持dual-mode operation——同一PE可配置为BQK mode（MAC only）或SLNV mode（先exp via 6 sequential MACs，再MAC with BV）；(2) NoC支持packet-level multiplexing——相邻cycle可传输不同Einsum的数据；(3) Static schedule——由于所有tile size和通信模式在编译时已知，可offline生成per-cycle PE和link的调度表→硬件仅需按表执行（no runtime synchronization）。此技术与GPU warp specialization（如FlashAttention-3）不同：GPU通过warp-level software pipelining + async copy隐藏latency，但因SIMT的lockstep执行和高同步成本→utilization仅~61%（vs FuseMax ~100%）。FPGA systolic array可实现类似fine-grain interleaving via modulo scheduling，但受限于FPGA routing congestion。

涉及论文标题：
- 5-FuseMax_Leveraging_Extended_Einsums_to_Optimize_Attention_Accelerator_Design.pdf

## Timeloop + Accelergy (DNN Accelerator Modeling Toolchain)

术语解释
Timeloop和Accelergy是MIT/Stanford开发的DNN accelerator design space exploration工具链。Timeloop建模accelerator architecture并搜索最优mapping（loop order/tiling/parallelization）；Accelergy提供architecture-level energy estimation。二者结合可对给定workload在给定architecture上评估execution time、energy和area，广泛用于accelerator architecture research。

术语是什么？
**Timeloop [41]**（https://github.com/NVlabs/timeloop）：接受三层specification——(1) Problem: workload的loop nest dimensions（Einsum-like spec，如GEMM M,N,K）；(2) Architecture: PE array topology、buffer hierarchy sizes、NoC bandwidth、compute unit capabilities；(3) Mapping: loop order constraints、tiling factors、spatial parallelization。Timeloop的mapper搜索mapping space以最小化runtime（cycle count），评估每个mapping的data movement（DRAM↔global buffer↔PE buffer↔compute）和compute cycles（含pipeline fill/drain）。输出：optimal mapping、execution cycles、data movement volume per memory level。

**Accelergy [56]**（https://github.com/nelliewu95/accelergy）：接受architecture component的energy model（per-access energy for SRAM/DRAM at given technology node, per-operation energy for MAC/exp/div/add max etc., NoC hop energy）和Timeloop的activity counts（各component的access/operation次数），计算total energy breakdown。Energy model可来自CACTI（SRAM/DRAM）、published circuit designs、或custom plug-ins。

从编译框架角度拆解术语：
FuseMax使用Timeloop+Accelergy的完整评估流程：
```
1. Architecture Specification (YAML):
   arch:
     - 2D_PE_array: { dimensions: [M0,P0], MAC/cycle: 1, exp: 6 MACs }
     - 1D_PE_array: { dimensions: [256], ops: [add, max, mul, div] }
     - GlobalBuffer: { size: X KB, bandwidth: Y GB/s }
     - DRAM: { size: ∞, bandwidth: Z GB/s }
     - NoC: { topology: mesh, hop_energy: E_pJ }

2. Einsum Specification (for each Einsum in Cascade 5):
   einsum BQK:
     iteration_space: [E, M0, P]
     inputs:
       - Q: { coordinates: [e, p], datawidth: fp16 }
       - BK: { coordinates: [e, m0], datawidth: fp16 }
     output: BQK { coordinates: [m0, p], datawidth: fp16 }
     compute: multiply-add (MACC)

3. Timeloop Mapping Search:
   - Mapper searches: loop_order, tiling_factors, spatial_parallelization
   - Objective: minimize cycles subject to buffer capacity constraints
   - Output: optimal mapping + activity counts

4. Accelergy Energy Estimation:
   - Input: architecture energy models + Timeloop activity counts
   - Output: energy breakdown (DRAM/GlobalBuffer/PE_array/NoC)

5. Full Cascade Combination (TeAAL heuristics [35]):
   - Merge per-Einsum results considering:
     a. Pipeline overlap (epoch-level software pipelining)
     b. Tile dependency stalls (e.g., RM must wait for LM drain)
     c. Shared resource contention (DRAM BW, global buffer BW)
   - Total cycles = max(compute-bound time, memory-bound time)
     after accounting for pipeline overlap
   - Total energy = Σ(per-Einsum energy) - overlap savings
```

术语一般如何实现？如何使用？
Timeloop+Accelergy被广泛用于accelerator architecture research（MICRO/ISCA/ASPLOS/HPCA等顶会论文的标准评估工具）。安装：`pip install timeloop-accelergy`或通过Docker。典型workflow：(1) 定义architecture YAML（PE array、memory hierarchy、NoC）；(2) 定义workload YAML（Einsum/problem dimensions）；(3) 运行`timeloop-mapper arch.yaml workload.yaml map.yaml -o output/`；(4) 运行`accelergy arch.yaml output/ -o energy/`；(5) 脚本处理输出（parse stats.txt + energy.txt）。FuseMax artifact（https://github.com/FPSG-UIUC/micro24-fusemax-artifact）提供完整Docker化环境+Jupyter notebooks展示此流程。局限性：(1) Timeloop原生仅支持single Einsum mapping search，cascade-level scheduling（如cross-Einsum interleaving）需手动编码为mapping constraints；(2) 不支持cycle-accurate simulation —— pipeline overlap需通过external heuristics估计；(3) technology scaling依赖Accelergy plug-in model准确度。

## EDGE: Extended General Einsums Notation

术语解释
EDGE (Extended General Einsums) 是一种扩展Einsum符号系统，支持表达传统Einsum（BLAS、tensor network contraction）无法处理的复杂tensor algebra computations（如graph algorithms、attention with softmax等），通过user-defined map/reduce/populate actions提供可定制计算语义。

术语是什么？
EDGE [39]将Einsum的计算分离为三个"actions"：(1) **map**（map action）：指定two tensors的shared rank上的pair-wise computation，包含merge operator（指定iteration space中哪些points需被touched）和compute operator（指定对两个data values执行的操作）。(2) **reduce**（reduce action）：指定reduction step，同样包含merge和compute。(3) **populate**（=）：将RHS计算值放入LHS tensor的对应位置。EDGE支持user-defined merge operators（∩ intersection—touch points where both operands non-zero、∪ union—touch points where at least one operand non-zero、← left—touch points where left/target operand non-zero、1 pass-through—touch all points）和compute operators（× multiply、+ add、max maximum、÷ divide、sub-then-exp subtraction then exponentiation、σ sigmoid等）。EDGE还支持：(1) iterative/generative ranks——表达递归和迭代计算（如prefix sum, running max）；(2) filtering rank expressions——只touch tensor subset（如A_{k:k≤i}）；(3) shorthand notation——drop default reduce actions、infix notation for map、operator-specific shorthand（如max(A,B)、A/B、e^{A-B}）。

从编译框架角度拆解术语：
EDGE作为specification language表达attention kernel的完整计算（以Cascade 5的Einsum 47为例）：
```
# Full EDGE spec:
SLN_{m1,m0,p} = BQK_{m1,m0,p} · RM_{m1+1,p} :: _{m0} sub-then-exp(1)
# - map action: between BQK and RM on rank (shared rank of sub-then-exp)
# - merge: 1 (pass-through, touch all m0 points)
# - compute: sub-then-exp → first BQK - RM, then exp(result)
# - reduce: none (no reduction on m0, SLN retains m0 rank)

# Shorthand notation:
SLN_{m1,m0,p} = e^{BQK_{m1,m0,p} - RM_{m1+1,p}}
```
EDGE如何帮助FuseMax的分析：(1) Pass分析——EDGE显式表达每个Einsum的iteration space和data dependencies，使is-ﬁbertree的read-after-write关系可被机械推导；(2) Reassociation validation——利用分配律变换cascade时，EDGE的precise semantics保证functional equivalence（如从3-pass到1-pass的变换）；(3) Fusion legality check——EDGE的merge operator定义哪些points被touch，可机械检测两个Einsum的iteration space overlap和fusion safety。

术语一般如何实现？如何使用？
EDGE的reference implementation未公开（论文[39] on ArXiv 2024）。其核心思想受TeAAL [35]（sparse tensor accelerator modeling）和TACO（sparse tensor algebra compiler）影响。在FuseMax中，EDGE用作analysis和specification tool，而非compilation target——cascade经过EDGE form formalized后，manually translated to Timeloop workload specification。EDGE的表达力超越传统Einsum的限制：(1) non-linear operations（exp, sigmoid, max）可直接表达，无需decompose为multiple lower-level Einsums；(2) iterative ranks使recursive algorithms（如1-pass running softmax）可被代数式而非imperative伪代码描述。未来可能将EDGE集成到accelerator compiler pipeline作为higher-level IR，自动derive mapping constraints and fusion opportunities。

涉及论文标题：
- 5-FuseMax_Leveraging_Extended_Einsums_to_Optimize_Attention_Accelerator_Design.pdf
